(iii) Hence, find the solution to $u_n + 2u_{n-1} = 3n - 2$, $n \ge 1$ where $u_1 = 7$. [10]
(b) Find the solution of the recurrence relation $u_n = 2u_{n-1} - 2u_{n-2}$, $n \ge 2$, where $u_0 = 2$, $u_1 = 2$. Express your solution in the form $2^{f(n)}\cos(g(n)\pi)$, where the functions $f$ and $g$ map $\mathbb{N}$ to $\mathbb{R}$. [7]
